{{Quote|This camp is destroyed. There isn't anyone here.|A spacer, to [[Lisum]]|<ref name="SWG:TMR" />}}
A '''Research Camp''' located in the wilderness of the planet [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]] was used by a group of researchers during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. The camp was eventually destroyed by the [[Canopy bandits]] and the scientists were assassinated.

==Description==
{{Quote|Of course they are around there. They are the researchers in charge of the camp.|Lisum, to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:TMR" />}}
The camp was located in the region of [[Kachirho/Legends|Kachirho]], north of the city, on the planet Kashyyyk. It consisted of several rather primitive tents made from wood from the surrounding forest and brown tarpaulin. The camp was set up by a group of researchers came to the [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] homeworld to study the local flora. The researchers used a radio to communicate with other scientists based off-world.<ref name="SWG:TMR" />

==History==
{{Quote|Hello? Who is this? I am looking for the people who are working in the camp. Can you please put one of them on?|Lisum talking over the radio|<ref name="SWG:TMR" />}}
The research camp was built by a group of scientists, including [[Jillian]], [[Bathoz]] and [[Rengar]], after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]]. Although they knew that Kashyyyk could be a unsafe place, they decided to study the local plant life.<ref name="SWG:TMR" />

In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> the dangerous [[Canopy bandits]] attacked the camp, abducted the researchers and destroyed the camp.<ref name="SWG:TMR" />

[[File:Kashyyyk_dead_researchers.jpg|thumb|left|250px|The corpses of the dead researchers.]]
When a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] came upon the camp not long after the attack, he found it ravaged and deserted. While investigating the camp site, the spacer heard a plea for help over the radio. It came from another researcher, [[Lisum]], who was trying to contact his friends. The spacer promised to help Lisum uncover the researchers' fate. The word "Canopy" could be found scratched on a drum with [[Blood/Legends|blood]]. Lisum concluded that his friends had been taken by the Canopy bandits. He asked the spacer to travel to the [[Canopy bandit's camp|bandits' camp]] and search for the missing researchers. The spacer returned with bad news — all of Lisum's friends had been killed. Enraged, Lisum asked the spacer to kill the bandits and promised the contents of a sealed box left behind in the destroyed camp as a reward. When the spacer returned successfully from this attack on the Canopy bandits, Lisum revealed the code and the spacer retrieved a [[Jawa ion pistol]] from the safe box.<ref name="SWG:TMR" />

Around the same time, a spacer found a [[Corestrike Rancor]] [[Blaster carbine/Legends|carbine]] in the ruined camp.<ref name="SWG:RCWMI">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=collection|Rare Carbine Weapons Mark I}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Research Camp appeared in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:TMR" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> The Research Camp was added to the game with the release of the expansion pack [[Star Wars Galaxies: Rage of the Wookiees|''Rage of the Wookiees'']] on [[May 5]], [[2005]].<ref name="SWG:TMR" />
